description: Automatically maximizes application windows to keep controls and interface elements visible and accessible. Especially useful for web-based applications and for creating clear video tutorials and screen recordings.
changelog:
- Added ability to exclude specific applications from automatic window maximization.
- Added an unassigned command to quickly add or remove the current application from the auto-maximize list.
- Added an excluded applications management list in AutoMaximize settings with Add, Remove, and Browse options.
- Added compatibility with NVDA 2026.3.
- Minor fixes and maintenance.
